title: Harness-Model Collaboration for Long-Horizon Continual Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.34724v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-horizon agents continuously encounter reusable procedural knowledge, yet existing systems typically rely either on model adaptation or external memory, trading persistent learning for rapid reuse. This limitation is especially important for Web agents that repeatedly execute related multi-step workflows. We propose HaMo, a Harness-Model collaborative framework that combines fast non-parametric experience accumulation with slow parametric adaptation. HaMo distills trajectories into strategy-level experience cards for immediate retrieval, while an experience-conditioned continual learning objective trains the model to interpret, ground, and execute retrieved strategies across changing contexts. A retrieval-coverage-based selection mechanism further identifies compact and complementary trajectories for parameter updates. Experiments show that HaMo outperforms harness-only and model-only adaptation under within-domain and cross-domain s

translated_title: 面向长时程持续学习的智能体框架-模型协同
translated_abstract: 长时程智能体会持续遇到可复用的程序性知识，然而现有系统通常要么依赖模型适配，要么依赖外部记忆，以牺牲持久学习来换取快速复用。这一局限对于反复执行相关多步骤工作流的网络智能体尤为重要。我们提出 HaMo，一种智能体框架与模型协同的框架，将快速的非参数经验积累与慢速的参数化适配相结合。HaMo 将轨迹蒸馏为策略级经验卡片以供即时检索，同时通过以经验为条件的持续学习目标，训练模型在不断变化的环境中解释、落地并执行检索到的策略。此外，基于检索覆盖率的筛选机制进一步为参数更新挑选出紧凑且互补的轨迹。实验表明，在域内和跨域设置下，HaMo 的表现优于仅用框架或仅用模型的适配方法。
tldr: 提出 HaMo 框架，通过将轨迹蒸馏为可即时检索的策略级经验卡片实现快速经验复用，并结合以经验为条件的持续学习训练模型跨环境执行策略，在域内和跨域长时程任务上同时超越仅用框架或仅用模型的适配方法。
en_tdlr: HaMo combines fast non-parametric experience cards with an experience-conditioned continual learning objective, enabling long-horizon agents to achieve both rapid strategy reuse and persistent parametric learning, outperforming harness-only and model-only adaptation in within-domain and cross-domain settings.
